title_note: on synthetic data with known ground truth

setup.target: monthly hotel guests (and guest nights) by nationality
setup.inputs_at_forecast_time: flight schedule (seats) for the test months, event and holiday calendars; load factor, transfer share and all conversion parameters estimated on training months only

selection.criterion: lowest mean CV WMAPE on hotel guests
